operation_details.item: The user's Channel 1 receives 40% of the media budget.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hey! How's the quarterly media planning going? I saw we're rebalancing channels soon.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, just reviewing allocations. We're keeping Channel 2 at 30% and Channel 3 at 20%, but Channel 1 got bumped to 40% of our media budget this quarter.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Nice, so Channel 1 is now the biggest slice. That's a significant shift from last cycle.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Definitely. It's a test — stronger reach on that platform, and we'll see how engagement holds up.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Given quarterly reviews, we can pivot if the numbers don't support it.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. We'll compare channel performance at the end of Q3 before locking anything in.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: So Channel 2 at 30% and Channel 3 at 20% stay steady for now, right?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Yes, those remain unchanged. Only Channel 1's 40% is the new variable.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only the 40% allocation for Channel 1, while keeping the allocations for Channels 2 and 3 and the review cycle.
